title: Priya - finance/legal personal todo (Q1 renewals)
content:
Quick scratchpad for invoices, contract redlines, and upcoming renewals. This is a living todo list - rough, terse, and meant for my inbox triage + sprint planning.

Context: Q1 vendor renewals and a few outstanding invoices for Redwood Dedicated onboarding projects. Legal asked for a prioritized list of redlines to clear before pilot starts. Finance needs confirmation on three invoices that hit > $50k.

TODAY (top priority)
- [ ] Invoice checks: verify POs + receipt attachments for big invoices
  - INV-2026-015 (NimbleOps) - $78,420. Waiting on vendor invoice upload (finance flagged missing W9). Reach out: Marco (finance) to confirm receipt; email vendor if not by EOD 2/27.
  - INV-2026-019 (EdgeScale) - $12,300. Approved by PM; hold until contract amendment processed.
  - INV-2026-021 (DataSafe) - $52,000. PO created but price mismatch vs SOW. TODO: Reconcile with SOW line items.

- [ ] Contract redlines (legal) - priority order for pilot contracts
  - Pilot SOW (NimbleOps) - redline doc in Slack thread #legal-pilot. Major ask: data retention clause (30 days) vs vendor wants 90 days. My note: propose 45 days + audit log retention. Owner: Sarah Liu (legal). Target: redline back to vendor by 3/3.
  - Master Services Agreement (EdgeScale) - vendor requested indemnity expansion. We should push back; propose capped liability + carveouts. Draft language to propose attached to this doc. Owner: Sarah.
  - Subcontractor Addendum (DataSafe) - verify flowdown obligations. Quick scan shows missing insurance minimums.

- [ ] Renewals calendar
  - SSO provider (AuthFlow) - renewal 2026-03-15. Auto-renews; need cancellation notice by 2/28 if we choose not to renew or change tier. Flag: usage spiked last month; check bill of usage with Marco.
  - Observability (PulseMetrics) - renewal 2026-04-01. Sales rep offered 10% reduction for annual commit; prepare negotiation pitch (cost + feature gaps). Owner: me; schedule sync with Eng Observability on 3/1.

- [ ] Misc legal admin
  - NDA template updates: add clause for sandbox data deletion. Small change but affects all new vendor NDAs. Add to backlog for legal template refresh.
  - KMS key rotation: confirm rotation schedule with infra security. Ticket SEC-4021.

NOTES / Draft text snippets (for quick copy-paste)
- Payment reconciliation ask to vendor: "Please confirm invoice number and attach signed SOW. We are unable to process INV-2026-015 until W9 is on file. Can you upload via the vendor portal or send to accounting@redwood.ai?"
- Proposed retention compromise (for NimbleOps): "Redwood requests a 45-day retention period for hosted logs related to pilot activity; vendor to retain audit logs for 12 months in encrypted form."

FOLLOW-UPS (who to ping)
- Marco Diaz (Finance) - confirm W9 receipt and PO status for INV-2026-015.
- Sarah Liu (Legal) - prioritize Pilot SOW redlines and confirm liability cap language for EdgeScale.
- Eng (Observability) - quick sync 3/1 re: PulseMetrics usage data.

RISK/OPEN QUESTIONS
- If vendor refuses 45-day retention, do we accept 90-day for pilot? Need exec signoff if so.
- Are there other invoices >$50k not in our list? Run a filter in Coupa for Jan-Feb.

QUICK ACTIONS (next 48h)
1) Email Marco re: INV-2026-015 (today).
2) Ping Sarah in Slack with the Pilot SOW redline priority (today).
3) Add NDA sandbox clause to legal template backlog (create ticket LEG-278).

Scratch / thoughts: keep redlines minimal for pilots - prefer operational guardrails vs heavy legal friction. If product schedule is tight, escalate cost of delay to PM for tradeoff.

---
Last quick log: 2026-02-27 09:12 AM - Sent Marco note; he confirmed W9 pending vendor upload. Follow-up scheduled 2/27 4pm.
